description: This file defines the LeaveRequestDetailedModel class, which is a PHP representation of a detailed leave request used within the OrangeHRM leave plugin API. It serializes leave request data into an array suitable for API responses, including employee info, leave periods, comments, and allowed actions.

classes.name: LeaveRequestDetailedModel
classes.description: A model class that serializes detailed leave request data for API output, including nested employee and leave type info, dates, balances, actions, and comments.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that accepts a DetailedLeaveRequest object and initializes the model.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Serializes the detailed leave request data into an associative array suitable for JSON API responses.
